//: Type-checking for the deployed source. There was no root tsconfig at all,
and the test harness compiles with strict:false because its job is to EMIT
runnable JS for the assertions rather than to judge types. The consequence
was that nothing checked api/ under strict mode before a deploy — type
errors would have surfaced on Vercel, at the worst possible moment.
Running it found ZERO errors: the code was already strict-clean and simply
had nothing proving it. This file makes that a guarantee instead of a
coincidence. `npm run typecheck` runs it; tools/run-tests.mjs runs it too,
so a type error fails the suite rather than the deployment.
